metadata.title: Evaluation
metadata.description: Start evaluation from this collection by curating datasets, publishing runnable versions, and handing them off to bot runs.

hero_title: Start evaluation from the collection, not from chat.
hero_description: This page is the first stop for evaluation. Create a dataset, publish its first version, and then jump into a bot run with a version that is already ready to execute.
first_use_description: Keep the first run simple. Build one dataset, publish one version with a real case, then move to a bot's Evaluation page to start the run.
first_use_dataset_hint: Create the dataset here so the evaluation entry stays anchored in the collection context.
first_use_version_hint: Publish the first version immediately. A dataset without a published version still cannot be used for runs.
first_use_run_hint: Once a version is ready, open a bot's Evaluation page and start a run with that dataset version id.
datasets_section_description: Use datasets to define what this collection should be tested against. Each card keeps the latest runnable version visible, so you can publish quickly and move straight into a run.
empty_description: Create a dataset here, publish its first version, and then continue into a bot run. This page is the evaluation starting point for the collection.
create_dataset_description: Start with a small, real dataset. You can publish the first version right after this step.
dataset_description_placeholder: Describe what this dataset should validate and why it belongs to this collection.
create_dataset_missing_id: The backend created a dataset but did not return its id
create_dataset_success: Dataset created. Publish the first version next.
create_version_description: Add one real case so this dataset becomes runnable immediately.
create_version_description_named: Add one real case so {dataset} becomes runnable immediately.
create_version_helper: Keep the first version narrow. One representative case is enough to validate the flow end to end.
input_message_placeholder: Write the message that should be sent to the bot for this case.
expected_answer_placeholder: Optional. Capture the expected outcome for later judging.
reference_context_placeholder: Optional. Add any extra context or ground truth that should travel with this case.
create_version_input_required: Input message is required to publish a version
create_version_missing_id: The backend published a version but did not return its id
created_version_description: {dataset} now has a runnable version: {version}. The next step is to choose the target bot explicitly and start the run from that bot's Evaluation page.
choose_bot_hint: Do not rely on a default bot here. Open the target bot's Evaluation page explicitly, then paste this dataset version id to start the run.
error_title: Benchmark data could not be loaded
error_description: The benchmark endpoint returned an error. Please retry after the backend contract and server state are checked.
not_available_title: Benchmark APIs are not ready yet
not_available_description: The frontend route is in place. Data will populate here once the evaluation v2 backend endpoints land.
